name: desire for sleep
description: Physical or mental need for sleep.

guidance.description: If you're having trouble with sleep, consider researching on your own or seeking help.

variations.name: escape sleep
variations.description: Sometimes a nap can be triggered more from a desire for a short escape to quiet and comfort than from feeling sleepy.

commentaries.quote: Without enough sleep, we all become tall two year olds.
There is more refreshment and stimulation in a nap, even of the briefest, than in all the alcohol ever distilled.
I love sleep. My life has the tendency to fall apart when I'm awake, you know?
No day is so bad it can't be fixed with a nap.
